status: Managed provider snapshot/runtime modes, Geo and internal DNS; full G2/G3 and installed-service integration pending

subscription_updates.route: Direct by default; explicit RunningProxy or Auto; Auto retries one direct network failure through the ready owned core, never TLS/auth/content failures
subscription_updates.redirects: at most 5 HTTPS hops; reject downgrade, login details, fragments and loops; drop custom source headers across origins; no cookies
subscription_updates.deadline: 15 seconds per transfer, 20 seconds total across redirects and fallback; aggregate decoded response bodies at most 16 MiB
subscription_updates.conditional_cache: ETag and Last-Modified in DPAPI envelope bound to source URL/headers and sourceHash; send only to matching final URL; 304 requires verified local raw source or one unconditional refetch
subscription_updates.other_failure_backoff: at least 60 minutes and no shorter than configured interval
subscription_updates.activation: changed selected profile with autoApply uses confirmed transaction and compensation; stopped updates never start core
subscription_updates.unchanged: refresh metadata without core restart unless pending candidate awaits apply
subscription_updates.selection_identity: profileId, group policy HMAC without members, member HMAC and membership/capability readback

proxies.schema: src/infra/config/config_schema.cpp; per-protocol fields, required credentials, types and bounds

tuic_constraints.authentication: exactly one: nonempty token (v4) OR valid UUID and nonempty password (v5)
tuic_constraints.udp: native capability always true; explicit false rejected because pinned core ignores it
tuic_constraints.positive_integers: request-timeout and heartbeat-interval in milliseconds, max-udp-relay-packet-size in bytes, max-open-streams count; 1..1000000
tuic_constraints.alpn: at most 16 nonempty entries, each at most 64 bytes

load_balance_only.current: no single member for the group; individual connections retain their own chain

groups.manual_selection: Selector only; URLTest/Fallback display core-confirmed current member; LoadBalance exposes members without a single current member; explicit refresh, no client health-check loop

rules: RULE-SET (managed runtime references or expanded snapshot)

managed.secret: absent from semantic template; required per session with >=256-bit randomness

dns.enable: preserve validated subscription; false if absent

rejected: file/inline/MRS providers and unmanaged provider paths
all unclassified keys including nested keys

dns.path: Mihomo internal DNS, fake-ip/redir-host/normal; no external listener or OS DNS change
dns.resolvers: udp/tcp/tls/https, 1..256 entries per list; IP literal bootstrap; reject local files, userinfo, fragments, loopback/unspecified/IPv4-mapped loopback/localhost and scope identifiers
dns.validation: official isolated -t plus Ready; controlled internal DNS policy/filter/cache validation tracked in P3-08; external listener and OS DNS hijack tracked in P3-04

geo.snapshot: release_matrix.json geo by default; managed immutable geoip/geosite pair after explicit update
geo.writer: application only; stream at most 64 KiB per read and 32 MiB per database; verify existing hash paths before reuse; isolated official dual-database validation and normal configuration transaction
geo.manual_update: fixed MetaCubeX HTTPS sources; pair unchanged avoids restart; download/validation cancellation rejects late replies; previous pair and explicit bundled fallback retained
geo.tun: bundled resources only until managed service resource support

providers.default_mode: snapshot; explicit per-profile runtime opt-in downloads and validates all resources before the normal apply transaction
providers.accepted: HTTP type over HTTPS without userinfo/fragment; proxy YAML; rule YAML/text with classical/domain/ipcidr; use and RULE-SET references must resolve
providers.snapshot_download: application writer; no redirects; 10 seconds transfer/15 seconds total; 64 KiB chunks; 32 resources, 4 MiB each, 16 MiB total; immutable source/body SHA-256 binding
providers.snapshot_refresh: download selected resource only; verified cache for the rest; missing or corrupt cache requires full update; failed candidate preserves old state
providers.runtime_config: application generated cache identity from kind/name/URL/format/behavior; source path ignored; checked import fallback payload embedded; interval default 0, allowed 0..604800 seconds; size-limit 4194304
providers.runtime_writer: core only while running; application/service removes inactive or oversized generated files only while core stopped; refuse links, directories and unknown entries; at most 32 files/128 MiB body cache
providers.runtime_network: pinned core TLS/redirect/parser behavior; YAML rules require standard multiline payload; malformed individual rules can be ignored by core; read back actual ruleCount
providers.runtime_refresh: fixed PUT provider endpoint; service accepts only active allowlisted kind/name, no URL/path/extra fields; no core restart or snapshot mutation; timeout outcome uncertain, no automatic retry
providers.selection: provider-only nodes and static/dynamic name collisions are unverified; explicit live selection allowed, never persist or automatically restore; failed provider readback cannot authorize restore
providers.history_backup: history restores logical configuration/import fallback, not a frozen later runtime cache; both backup scopes export immutable import fallback, source scope also retains raw YAML/overlay; restore in snapshot mode
providers.service_validation: fixed command boundary tested; actual installed service and TUN integration tracked separately in P3-25

diagnostics.privacy: fixed feature vocabulary, structural index paths, phase only; never arbitrary YAML keys, names, URLs or values; English and Chinese presentation

parser: yaml-cpp 0.9.0; preserved original bytes stored separately in P2; no comment round trip guarantee
